Description: NIST SP 800-122 PII Confidentiality Impact Level
RightSideHtmlBlock:
PII confidentiality impact level

Rate the potential harm to the individuals and to the organization from the PII exposed in this move. Harm to the organization includes administrative burden, financial losses, loss of public reputation and confidence, and legal liability.

LevelHarm (SP 800-122 examples)
Not applicablePII the organization may release publicly
Lowwould not cause harm greater than inconvenience, such as changing a telephone number
Moderatefinancial loss due to identity theft or denial of benefits, public humiliation, discrimination, or potential for blackmail
Highserious physical, social, or financial harm, resulting in potential loss of life, loss of livelihood, or inappropriate physical detention

This level supplements the FIPS 199 confidentiality impact; it does not replace it.

Source: NIST SP 800-122, Guide to Protecting the Confidentiality of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) (2010), Section 3.1.

$values.Description: PII confidentiality impact level - harm to individuals and the organization if the PII were inappropriately accessed, used, or disclosed
Not applicable - PII the organization may release publicly
Low - would not cause harm greater than inconvenience, such as changing a telephone number
Moderate - financial loss due to identity theft or denial of benefits, public humiliation, discrimination, or potential for blackmail
High - serious physical, social, or financial harm, resulting in potential loss of life, loss of livelihood, or inappropriate physical detention
